newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Gucci tops slow ADR trade.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Gucci tops slow ADR trade.

text.p: Luxury goods maker Gucci Group NV highlighted quiet pre-Easter holiday trade in American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) on Thursday.
"Business has been fairly thin, but people are squaring up their books at the end of the quarter and ahead of the long weekend," said one trader. "It's been a bit illiquid today."
Gucci rose one to 71-7/8 after it reported that its 1996 profits more than doubled. Volume was almost 700,000 ADRs traded, almost twice the average daily volume.
The company's ADRs rose as high as 73-5/8 before falling back.

Most Latin American exchanges were closed for the Easter holiday and trade in regional ADRs was slim. Telefonica del Peru SA rose 1/8 to 22-1/2 in heavy volume dominated by a 471,000-share block trade.
ADRs in Britain's Getty Communications Plc fell 7/8 to 14-7/8. Trade was relatively heavy, at 393,000 ADRs, and featured a 187,500-ADR block trade handled by Alex. Brown, market traders said.
Decliners led advancers by 236 to 216 among 806 ADRs. The ADR index was up 0.08 percent and volume was 27 millino shares in late morning.
